test_title: PYST 17: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 11 Feb, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word.

The explorer encountered an ancient __artifact__ in the cave.

options.text: An object made by humans, usually of historical or cultural significance

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. "An object made by humans, usually of historical or cultural significance".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"artifact"** refers to an object made by humans, often of historical, cultural, or archaeological significance. (हस्तनिर्मित वस्तु)

 
 
• **Example:** The museum displayed ancient artifacts from the Indus Valley Civilization.
 
 
 
• An artifact can be anything ranging from tools, pottery, ornaments, or remnants that provide insight into the past civilizations and cultures. (प्राचीन वस्तुएं)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: A sudden burst of energy** (अचानक ऊर्जा का प्रस्फुटन): Refers to a quick and intense release or surge of energy.

 
 
• **Example:** The athlete felt a sudden burst of energy as he crossed the finish line.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: A type of insect** (कीट का प्रकार): Refers to a specific classification of small, six-legged creatures.
 
 
• **Example:** The scientist discovered a new type of insect in the Amazon rainforest.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: A form of currency** (मुद्रा का प्रकार): Refers to a system or medium of exchange used in economic transactions.
 
 
• **Example:** Gold coins were once used as a form of currency in ancient times.
 
 

35:Tdda,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
